title: WPSS/443/2013 of Sidarth Kotnala Vs Chief Education Officer Pauri Garhwal AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (S/S) No. 443 of 2013
Sidarth Kotnala Ö..Ö Petitioner
Versus
Chief Education Officer Pauri Garhwal
 & others ÖÖ Respondents
Present: Mr. Ravi Babulkar, Advocate, present for the petitioner.
 Mr. B.P.S. Mer, learned Brief Holder, present for the
State/respondent no.1.
 Mr. Navnish Negi, Advocate, present for the respondent
no. 4.
Honíble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J. (Oral)
1. The petitioner, who is an Assistant Teacher (L.T.
Grade) in grant-in-aid private college, namely, Inter College,
Motadhak, Pauri Garhwal who has challenged the order dated
05.04.2013, passed by the Chief Education Officer, Pauri
Garhwal, by which the Chief Education Officer has held that the
petitioner is not eligible for consideration to the post of Lecturer
(Economics) in the Institute and has further given directions to
the Management Committee to send the name of the private
respondent no. 4 for the post of Lecturer (Economics).
2. Brief facts of the case are that, in the Institute in
question, the post of Principal was lying vacant since long (the
exact date has not been disclosed by any of the parties).
Admittedly, however, there was a vacancy of Principal on
18.10.2011. According to the Notification dated 18.10.2011, on
the post of Principal in all grant-in-aid Colleges who are eligible
Lecturers, and have put in 10 years of service as a Lecturer will
be considered for the post of Principal on a downgrade salary
and after putting 05 years of service will be given regular salary
of Principal. On the strength of the said notification, one Mr.
Raghuveer Singh Negi, who was working on the post of Lecturer
(Economics) in the said Institute and was the senior most
Lecturer, having all the qualifications for the aforesaid

2
promotion, was ultimately promoted vide order dated
20.07.2012 to the post of Principal on a downgrade salary.
However, in the said order the reference of the Notification
dated 18.10.2011 has been made but it has also been stated
that he is deemed to be promoted w.e.f. 18.10.2011.
3. In view of this Court, the date of promotion of Mr.
Raghuveer Singh Negi should not have been w.e.f. 18.10.2011,
but it should have been the date on which he was actually
promoted i.e.20.07.2012 and, consequently, the vacancy of
Lecturer (Economics) shall also be considered w.e.f. 20.07.2012
and not from 18.10.2011, as is the case of the respondents. On
20.07.2012, the present petitioner as well as the private
respondent no. 4, both being an Assistant Teacher (L.T. Grade),
were eligible for the post of Lecturer (Economics). According to
the petitioner, the two primary requirements for promotion to
the post of Lecturer are that he/she should be an Assistant
Teacher (L.T. Grade) and shall have put in 05 years of service
on a substantive capacity and, second that he/she must be post
graduate in the concerned subject.
4. According to the petitioner, he was a post graduate in
Economics on the said date when the vacancy occured i.e. on
20.07.2012 and he had also put in five years of service by that
time as he was initially appointed in the capacity of Assistant
Teacher (L.T. Grade) on 15.12.2006. Consequently, he fulfilled
all the eligibility requirements for the post.
5. The respondent no. 4, though is much senior to the
petitioner. His initial date of appointment on the post of
Assistant Teacher (L.T. Grade) is of 15.12.1994 and he is also a
postgraduate in economics. Therefore, as per the Regulations of
2009, framed under the Uttarakhand School Education Act,
2006, the criteria for promotion as per Rule 6 (3) of the Rules of
2009 would be seniority subject to the qualification as referred
above and since admittedly, respondent no. 4 is not only

3
qualified as a Lecturer but he is also senior to the petitioner,
hence as per the rules governing their service conditions it was
respondent no. 4 who was liable to be promoted on the post of
Lecturer (Economics), and there should not be any difficulty in
understanding and accepting all this. However, the case of the
respondent no. 4 was not considered as at the relevant time he
was an accused in a criminal case (Case Crime No. 2630 of
2008), for the offence under Section 306 of I.P.C. (i.e. abetting
the commission of suicide), which was registered at Police
Station ñ Kotdwar in District Pauri Garhwal in which later
charge sheet was filed against the respondent no. 4 on
22.11.2008, and charges were framed against him on
20.04.2010. Therefore, on the relevant date when the vacancy of
Lecturer (Economics) had come up in the Institute, the
respondent no. 4 should have been considered only by way of a
sealed cover procedure. Nevertheless, the sealed cover
procedure was not adopted and the name of the petitioner was
sent by the ìauthorized controllerî (which was functioning in
the place of Management Committee at the relevant time). The
District Education Officer, however, rejected the proposal vide
order dated 05.04.2013 stating that the vacancy arose on
18.10.2011 and the petitioner has not put in five years of
service on substantive vacancy on such date and directed the
Management Committee/Authorize Controller to send the name
of the respondent no. 4.
6. Meanwhile, it is again admitted that in the criminal
trial, respondent no.4 has been acquitted. Therefore, as of now
there is no criminal case pending against respondent no.4. It is
unfortunate that a sealed cover procedure was not adopted
which should have been the right method under the
circumstances. Had it been adopted, the respondent no. 4 was
liable to be recommended, as he was admittedly senior to the
petitioner.

4
7. The present writ petition therefore is liable to be
dismissed and it is hereby dismissed as no interference can be
made against the order impugned. Respondent no.4 has been
unduly harassed, as had the sealed cover procedure been
adopted in the matter respondent no.4ís name was the name
which could have been sent. As compared to the petitioner,
respondent no.4 has to be preferred.
8. This court has also been informed that the name of
the respondent no.4 has already been sent by the Authorized
Controller for the post of Lecturer (Economics). Therefore, the
Chief Education Officer, Pauri Garhwal is directed to take
decision on the proposal within a period of two weeks from the
date of presentation of certified copy of this order before him. It
is, however, made clear that vacancy shall be deemed to have
come up on 20.07.2012 and respondent no. 4ís claim will be
considered after that date.
9. No order as to costs.
